ruling.recommended_action: Close the dispute: the $6.61 cancellation fee stands as validly raised under NS-1; no refund and no account action.
ruling.reasoning:
The rider was charged a $6.61 cancellation fee after the driver cancelled as a no-show [F4][F7]. NS-0 routes the fee to NS-1/NS-2 because `cancelled_by = driver` and the driver asserts the rider did not show [F4]. NS-1 requires (i) an arrival confirmation, (ii) the GPS placing the driver within the pickup range at the moment of that confirmation, and (iii) a continuous wait of more than 3 minutes at the pickup after the confirmation, until cancellation [NS-1]. The trace marks all three as settled ✓, and the facts bear that out: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 17:19:15 at 41 m from the pickup [F6], inside the 200 m data-layer radius, and the closest approach overall was 35 m [F1]. After the tap he stayed within 200 m of the pickup for 3 min 40 s and cancelled at 17:22:55 [F6][F4][F5], which exceeds the NS-1 default threshold of more than 3 minutes (3:01) [NS-1]. NS-2's $6.61 full refund therefore is not available, since none of (i)–(iii) failed [NS-2].

The rider's account that she "came out a minute after the driver cancelled" is a statement only [F4]; the system record shows the driver first within 200 m at 17:17:50 and 5 min 5 s of cumulative time within 200 m before cancelling [F2][F3][F5], with the driver stationary 17:18:50–17:22:55 at 54 m from the pickup [F3]. No arrival by the rider appears anywhere in the record, so the fee was properly triggered [F2][F5][NS-1][NS-0].

No abuse of the "I'm Here" button arises on this record: the tap was inside the radius [F6], so the NS-2 flag trigger (m_from_pickup_at_tap > 200) is not met, and the trace records flag_account as not required [F6][NS-2]. The $6.61 is exactly Ryde's published cancellation fee with no surge component (1.0×), so there is no overcharge for FARE-1 to strip out [F7][F8][FARE-1]. Any refund would in any event be a Ryde voucher, not cash, and Ryde retains final discretion [NS-7].

Safety screen: I read all messages and the statement — the driver's arrivals notice and the cancellation notice are courteous and functional, and the complaint contains no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation [F9][F10][F12]; nothing triggers SAFE-1 or SAFE-2. Evidence: the chat record is complete with both messages timestamped [F11] and the GPS trace covers the period up to cancellation without a hole [F2][F6], so the decisive elements are all settled on the record.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider's complaint rests only on her unsupported statement that she came out a minute after cancellation [F4]; the system record shows the driver within 200 m since 17:17:50 and stationary 54 m away through the cancellation, with no rider arrival recorded [F2][F3][F5], so no full refund of the $6.61 can be founded and NS-2 does not apply [NS-2][NS-1].
